title: Cylindrical object
spec: Create a new coordinate system with the Euler angles set to zero degrees and the translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, draw a circle centered at coordinates [0.0154, 0.0154] with a radius of 0.0154. In the second loop, draw another circle with the same center but a smaller radius of 0.0141. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0307 to the entire two-dimensional sketch to adjust its size. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it using the same translation vector to position it correctly in three-dimensional space. Extrude the sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction to create a three-dimensional solid body. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. The final dimensions of the cylindrical object are a length of 0.030737704918032786 units, a width of 0.030737704918032786 units, and a height of 0.75 units. This process results in a cylindrical object with a small rectangular protrusion at the top.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the cylindrical base
workplane = workplane.center(0.0154, 0.0154)  # Move the origin to the center of the circle

# Create the outer circle
workplane = workplane.circle(0.0154)

# Create the inner circle (for the hole)
workplane = workplane.circle(0.0141)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylindrical body
cylinder = workplane.extrude(0.75)

# The final model 'r' is the cylindrical body
r = cylinder

# Display the model

    workplane
    .center(0.0154, 0.0154)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0154)  # Draw the outer circle
    .circle(0.0141)  # Draw the inner circle
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch for the top face
r = r.moveTo(0, 0.0154) \
     .threePointArc((0.0154, 0.0308), (0.0308, 0.0154)) \
     .threePointArc((0.0154, 0.0), (0.0, 0.0154)) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the body
r = r.extrude(0.75)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
